calls.title: Kevin Prawira and Jake Heier
calls.summary: The meeting outlined the process for establishing a company-wide Growth Book account and clarifying the transition from PoC to enterprise licenses, emphasizing the separation of company accounts from personal ones. Key roles were assigned, with Kevin and Jessica managing admin tasks and addressing potential email conflicts. The need for standardized experiment setup and approval processes was discussed to prevent inconsistencies, along with a requirement for global filters in dashboards to aid data analysis. Additionally, API integrations for automated experiment syncing were highlighted to improve efficiency. Lastly, the team requested more transparency regarding the product roadmap to enhance planning and preparation.
calls.keywords: Growth Book onboarding, experiment standardization, SDK orchestration, BigQuery integration, approval workflow, experiment dashboard filters
